markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Normal (71%)** · Ambiguous: Normal vs InSitu · Careful review
InSitu (25%) remains in the 90% set on this resampled frozen section; deeper levels drafted [F1].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Normal 71%, InSitu 25%, Invasive 3%, Benign 1% (ECE 5%) | Low invasive risk; InSitu possible |
| Conformal set | Normal, InSitu (90% target; 90% coverage, n=132) | Cannot rule out InSitu |
| Reliability / OOD | 96% reliability, 94% OOD, 12/12 tiles [F6]; AUROC 70% | Passes QC despite high OOD |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Agree on top class | Backbones agree on top class |
| Similar cases | 4/5 Normal (80%) [F5]; BACH_0302 Benign (81%) | Neighbors mostly match Normal |

## Tissue evidence
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (regions 2, 6, 9) · ↓ invasive · Above-typical score lowers invasive risk (20/20) [F2] · Validated
- **Dense lymphocytic infiltrate (TILs)** (region 5) · context · Below-typical score; descriptive only (8/20) [F3] · Weak
- **Atypical cells confined within ducts** (region 2) · ↑ invasive · Below-typical confinement raises risk (12/20) [F4] · Weak

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful; top-3 region deletion drops risk beyond random (0.0114, 95% CI 0.0021–0.0197, n=132).
- **Concepts**: Unproven (0.0008, CI -0.0088–0.0064); AI-checked mitoses (0/20, weak), normal lobules (0/20), necrosis (3/20) Unreliable.

## Could be wrong if
- Severity-3 resampling (94% OOD) masks InSitu (25%) or Benign tissue like contrast BACH_0302 (81% similar).
- Clear margin call [F7] requires 100% threshold despite 95% superior (region 1) and 72% inferior (region 9) scores.

## Check on the slide
1. **Region 3**: Inspect highest-risk tile (24% risk) to exclude focal in situ or invasive carcinoma.
2. **Regions 1, 8, 9**: Check superior (95%), medial (44%), and inferior (72%) margins and region 9 stroma.
3. **Regions 2, 10**: Check ductal atypia and pleomorphism; confirm drafted deeper levels (frozen stains blocked).

found: The CONCH–MUSK row names Normal, but agreement.conch_musk_same_top only says the two models agree with each other; the JSON does not say which class they chose.
